caption: The drawing is divided into two main sections, with the upper part showcasing a black-and-white, high-contrast image of a patchwork quilt. The quilt is composed of multiple fabric pieces of varying textures and patterns, stitched together in a geometric arrangement with visible, decorative zigzag and cross stitches. Prominent among the patches are a rectangular section with wavy stitched lines, a section featuring an embroidered motif resembling a fan or mushroom shape, and other rectangular and irregular shapes. Below this, the lower section features a smaller, colored version of the same patchwork pattern set against a plain, light background. In this colored representation, the patches include hues of blue, orange, red, black, and light beige, with similarly visible stitching in colored threads (such as purple, red, and black), further emphasizing the seams between the patch sections. The overall composition highlights the similarities and differences between the monochrome and colored depictions of the same textile pattern.
title: Textile: Technique Demonstration
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
